paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), on various academic and practical benchmarks. The horizontal axis represents the dataset and metrics, listing nine categories: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis is labeled "Score (%)", ranging from 0 to 80 in increments of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with blue representing LLaMA-3-8B-it and orange representing Ours (Iterative RLHF). For each dataset, the bars are paired, with LLaMA-3-8B-it scoring approximately 79%, 66%, 62%, 43%, 58%, 59%, 20%, 40%, and 18%, and Ours (Iterative RLHF) scoring around 80%, 65%, 62%, 60%, 62%, 60%, 28%, 42%, and 26%, respectively. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. Overall, the chart provides a comparison of the two models across multiple benchmarks.
